verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API covers card/expense management, budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements, org structure, and webhooks, suggesting broad parity with UI functionality, but there is no evidence of a complete feature-parity guarantee or published OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate spec URLs 404), and no independent confirmation that every UI action (e.g., custom approval policy configuration, AI invoice coding agent actions) is exposed via API. missing for 10: a formal API-UI feature parity statement, working OpenAPI/swagger spec, and evidence that specific UI-only features (approval policies, AI coding agent, network vendor matching) are fully controllable via API.
